function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

message.content:
**Miami Intermodal Center – Amtrak & Florida East Coast Railway** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Location** | 1 SE 1st Ave, Miami, FL 33131 (just south of Miami International Airport) | | **Train services** | Amtrak Silver Meteor / Silver Star (to New York, Washington, etc.)
Florida East Coast Railway freight (no passenger service) | | **Pet policy** | • **Amtrak** allows pets on board for a fee (usually $25 per pet, up to 20 lb).
• Pets must be in a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area.
• No pets on the Florida East Coast freight trains. | | **Station amenities** | • Pet relief area (small fenced space with waste bags).
• Accessible elevators, restrooms, and seating.
• Wi‑Fi, vending machines, and a small café. | | **Accessibility** | • ADA‑compliant.
• Parking available (paid).
• Close to Metrorail (Miami Metrorail station) and Metromover. | | **Contact** | Amtrak: 305‑555‑1234 (customer service)
Station office: 305‑555‑5678 | **Why it’s pet‑friendly** - The station itself has a dedicated pet relief area, so you can give your dog a quick break before boarding. - Amtrak’s pet‑friendly policy means you can travel with your pet in a carrier for a modest fee. - The station’s central location and easy connections to other transit options make it convenient for travelers with pets. If you’re planning a trip from Miami and need to bring a pet, the Miami Intermodal Center is the most straightforward option. Just be sure to check Amtrak’s latest pet guidelines and book your pet’s spot in advance.
